evidence.text:
Berkshire is a residential real estate investor and manager, partnering with investors and consultants across the globe to deliver long-term value and innovative solutions.

Berkshire, founded in 1966, is a privately held U.S. real estate investment management company known for its innovative, vertically integrated operating platform and 60 years of experience in U.S. residential real estate. The firm partners with investors and consultants across the globe to deliver long-term value and innovative solutions.

As a proven owner-operator with a team of industry experts, we have cultivated dedicated teams across a range of residential real estate disciplines, including acquisitions, dispositions, development, portfolio management, debt capital markets, property operations,and capital raising.

Across our residential platform, Berkshire currently sponsors a closed-end, value fund series with fund vintages beginning in 2005; an open-end, core fund; and two closed-end debt fund series. In addition, the Firm manages separate accounts focused on equity and debt investments in market-rate apartments and alternative sectors, including senior housing, single-family rentals, student housing, and manufactured housing.

At Berkshire, our strength as a national, vertically integrated investor and operator lies in our ability to anticipate change and lead with innovation. By investing in technology and empowering our people, we create communities where residents thrive and deliver enduring value for our partners.

Berkshire has over $34 billion of real estate assets under management, including over 480,000 residential units owned, managed, or overseen across the U.S.[[1]](https://berkshireresi.com/disclosures/)Explore our featured properties for a look at the Berkshire footprint.

Gulf Coast Property Management assists property owners and investors with the business of renting their homes. We bridge the gap between landlords and tenants by providing professional leasing and management services on their behalf.

We have been managing properties throughout Manatee and Sarasota counties since 2003. During this time, we have served thousands of owners, helping them navigate the complex rental property market. Our full service, comprehensive packages includes marketing, rent collection, inspections and everything in between.

We focus on property management, not real estate sales. This approach has allowed us to develop an expertise that delivers consistent results for our clients.
